name: Biomedical Sciences Doctoral Portal (PhD)
detailsNote: Official information available; the portal says applications are due "by December 1 of the year before matriculation", which is a rule rather than a dated Fall 2027 deadline. The stipend has no year on the page.
summary: Single doorway to six PhD programs in the VCU School of Medicine. Students can do research rotations in a wide range of participating labs.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline
publishedDeadlines.dateText: December 1 of the year before matriculation
publishedDeadlines.note: Applications are accepted beginning August 1. For matriculation in 2027 this points to December 1, 2026, but the page states the rule, not a Fall 2027 date.

timeline.decisions: Applicants have until April 15 to accept a training position in the BSDP.

english.note: Minimums as the page states them. International students must provide TOEFL or IELTS scores (VCU code 5570).

applicationFee.note: The page says application fee waivers are not currently being provided by the BSDP.

requirements.note: GRE scores are not evaluated even if provided. Letters should comment on suitability for graduate training.

funding.note: Full-time doctoral students typically receive financial support that includes a stipend, currently $36,600 per year (no year is given). The page does not say whether this covers international students.

sources.label: VCU School of Medicine: Biomedical Sciences Doctoral Portal
